name: _editors.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  cms/_editors.scss — shared editor layout helpers: manager grids,
//  subsection headers, field rows/groups, labels/hints, and the gravatar
//  editor (preview, controls, presets).
//  Imported by cms.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── CMS Editor Layout Helpers (About, Footer, Projects) ───────────────

// Card header variant.
.cms-card--header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-md);
}

// Per-locale section card.
.cms-card--lang {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

// Editor page wrappers — block containers so each .cms-card stacks with its
// own margin; named per manager for future per-section theming.
.cms-projects-manager,
.cms-portfolio-manager,
.cms-about-manager,
.cms-footer-manager,
.cms-playground-manager,
.cms-media-converter,
.cms-deploy-info {
  display: block;
}

// Subsection header — mirrors .cms-section-header at a lower hierarchy
// level (list title + optional inline controls).
.cms-subsection-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

// Grouped action buttons.
.cms-btn-group {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
}

// Section header row (title + actions).
.cms-section-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

// Section title.
.cms-section-title {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: $cms-accent;
  margin: 0 0 var(--space-sm);
  display: block;
}

// Nested subsection block.
.cms-subsection {
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
  padding: var(--space-md);
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

// Subsection heading.
.cms-subsection-title {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: $cms-text-muted;
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

// Horizontal row of fields.
.cms-field-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(to-rem(200px), 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-md);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);

  > .cms-btn {
    justify-self: start;
    align-self: end;
    width: auto;
    max-width: none;
  }
}

// Aligned field-row variant.
.cms-field-row--align {
  align-items: end;
}

// Compact field group.
.cms-field-group--small {
  max-width: to-rem(160px);
}

// Field label.
.cms-label {
  color: $cms-text-muted;
  font-weight: 500;
}

// Helper/hint text under a field.
.cms-hint {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: $cms-text-subtle;
  margin-top: var(--space-sm);
}

// Card subtitle.
.cms-card-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: $cms-text-muted;
  margin: 0;
}

// ── Gravatar Editor ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
.cms-gravatar-layout {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-xl);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

// Gravatar preview thumbnail.
.cms-gravatar-preview {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.cms-gravatar-img {
  width: to-rem(96px);
  height: to-rem(96px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  object-fit: cover;
  border: var(--space-3xs) solid $cms-accent;
}

.cms-gravatar-placeholder {
  width: to-rem(96px);
  height: to-rem(96px);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  background: $cms-bg-darker;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: to-rem(40px);
  border: var(--space-3xs) dashed $cms-border;
}

.cms-gravatar-label {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: $cms-text-subtle;
}

.cms-gravatar-controls {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: to-rem(280px);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.cms-preset-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-2xs);
}

.cms-input--short {
  max-width: to-rem(110px);
}

// Size-preset chip — ghost variant of .cms-btn: the solid accent base would
// render the active accent ink teal-on-teal, so presets sit on the dark panel
// tone and mark selection with an accent ring + ink instead.
.cms-btn--preset {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-md);
  background: $cms-bg-dark;
  color: $cms-text-primary;
  border: var(--space-hairline) solid $cms-border;

  &:hover {
    background: $cms-bg-dark;
    border-color: $cms-accent;
    transform: none;
  }
}

// Selected preset — accent ring + accent ink on the dark chip (readable).
.cms-btn--active {
  border-color: $cms-accent;
  color: $cms-accent;
}
